title: Sergio Perez hit with five-place penalty in Qatar after Rafael Camara clash during Las Vegas Grand Prix
paragraphs: Sergio Perez is set to take a five-place grid penalty next time out in Qatar after a collision with Haas’ Rafael Camara during the Las Vegas Grand Prix.
